request.prompt:
Generate a beautifully simple Chinese upstream/downstream detail page for Client Reach, a minimal AI Agent research workspace, using only real annual-report supplier and customer lists for 海能技术. Full-screen front-facing flat 16:9 desktop screenshot, designed at 1920x1080, high-resolution extremely legible Chinese, no device frame or perspective. This screen is about concrete obtainable relationships, NOT a complex knowledge graph.

EXACT SHARED STYLE: white #FFFFFF, near-white #F7F8FA, charcoal #20252C, muted #76808B gray, fine #E7EAEE borders, extremely light blue #EAF3FD selected elements and muted #597FA7 source links. BLACK / WHITE / GRAY / LIGHT BLUE ONLY. No teal, green, purple, orange, gradients, glowing lines, graph clouds or huge KPI tiles. Chinese font like Microsoft YaHei / Source Han Sans, readable 14–16px scale, 10px card radius, minimal shadow, clean spacing. Long names wrap, content determines row height.

APPLICATION SHELL: 176px pale gray sidebar, black square R logo "Client Reach", small subtitle "Agent 工作台". ONLY navigation "工作台", "查询结果", "设置". Query results selected. Bottom tiny avatar "林 / 本地工作空间". 56px white header "查询结果 / 企业详情", right "公开研究快照 · 2026-10-08". Never add relationships to the sidebar.

DETAIL HEADER: small "← 返回查询结果". Company monogram "海", full heading "海能未来技术集团股份有限公司", tags "海能技术", "集团资料". Quiet outline "导出资料" and "继续研究" buttons. Below company heading place a clear TOP DOCK segmented pill with EXACT options "客户画像", "采购信息", "上下游关系". Only relationship tab is selected with extremely light blue background.

MAIN BODY: title "年报披露的上下游", modest one-line caption "统计年度：2025 年 · 来源：公司年报". Two roomy natural-height white cards side by side, nearly equal width, clear horizontal gutters, calm whitespace below. No node-link diagram. Both cards are attractive business lists with precise labels and source links. Rows should flow naturally; the long supplier/customer names wrap and therefore create different row heights. Numbers right aligned; units visible. Use a tiny pale gray monogram or outline building icon for each row, not colorful badges.

LEFT CARD HEADING "上游供应商" and small subtitle "年度前五供应商 · 采购占比 17.24%". A small gray right label "采购额 / 年度占比". FIVE exactly named rows:
"CTC Analytics AG" / "428.94 万元" / "4.83%"
"江苏沃凯氟精密智造有限公司" / "399.77 万元" / "4.50%"
"河北磐仪分析仪器有限责任公司" / "289.80 万元" / "3.26%"
"石家庄莱博瑞分析仪器有限公司" / "220.60 万元" / "2.48%"
"上海侃达机电设备有限公司" / "192.97 万元" / "2.17%".
Totals footer "前五合计：1,532.08 万元". Tiny source link "2025 年报 · 供应商披露 ↗". IMPORTANT: label "具体采购物料、型号和次数未披露". Do NOT infer supplies of a particular component from a supplier name. A very small pale-blue progress bar may appear beside percentages, but keep list text dominant and avoid decorative charts.

RIGHT CARD HEADING "下游客户" and small subtitle "年度前五客户 · 销售占比 12.36%". Right small header "海能对其销售额 / 年度占比". FIVE exactly named rows:
"杭州国迈进出口有限公司" / "2,386.65 万元" / "6.60%"
"浙江省科学器材进出口有限责任公司" / "896.34 万元" / "2.48%"
"华测检测认证集团股份有限公司及其关联企业" / "445.66 万元" / "1.23%"
"Lab Service Analytica s.r.l." / "376.59 万元" / "1.04%"
"杭州汉一科学仪器有限公司" / "364.43 万元" / "1.01%".
Totals footer "前五合计：4,469.67 万元". Tiny source "2025 年报 · 客户披露 ↗". Clear small note "金额为海能对客户销售额，不是客户自身营收". Names wrap, not tiny unreadable strings.

Below both cards one wide understated natural-height card titled "关系说明" with only three readable short lines: "关系来自 2025 年报的具名披露。", "属于年度历史关系，不代表当前订单仍在进行。", "具体物料、单笔交易和当前采购联系人需要进一步核实。" Small outline button on right "让 Agent 继续核验". Keep the rest of the screen simple and open, with an optional fine footer "保留统计期与原始来源".

Carefully preserve all names, amounts and percent values, including all FIVE suppliers and FIVE customers. Do not invent companies or add graph edges. The UI must be minimal, advanced-looking, naturally adaptive, and immediately readable. The main emphasis is clear cards and lists containing evidence-backed facts with the shared top Dock and three-item sidebar.
